Name: Rhukiis Sprite Replacer
Author: Rhukii
Description:
This Mod adds sprites for artisan goods based on their ingredients, containing jelly, pickles, juice, wine and honey.

Sprites that will be replaced so far:
- ale
- beer
- cheese and goat cheese
- coffee and espresso
- green tea
- honey
- jelly
- juice
- mead
- milk and goat milk
- pickles
- wine

Due to it being my first mod ever I appreciate your feedback.

- replaces the 'green tea' sprite with one that is inspired by japanese tea cups
